headlines.title: Visa offers data to back onchain lending
headlines.summary: The card network aims to offer settlement and blockchain data so fintechs and card programs backed by stablecoins can better access onchain credit.
headlines.summary_tr: Bu haber, odeme aglari ve stablecoin tarafinda rekabetin sertlestigini ve finans altyapisinda yeni guc dengeleri olustugunu gosteriyor.
headlines.why_it_matters: Odeme ve finans altyapisindaki degisim yeni kazananlari ve islem akisini yeniden kurar. Bu sinyal özellikle fintech, settlement ekseninde öne çıkıyor.

headlines.title: Learn how AVs and robotics are laying the groundwork for field deployments at RoboBusiness
headlines.summary: ASI CEO Mel Torrie will explore why the intersection of autonomous vehicles and robotics will further revolutionize field deployments.
headlines.summary_tr: Bu haber, robotik uygulamalarin laboratuvar asamasindan cikip gercek operasyonlara daha fazla girdigini gosteriyor.
headlines.why_it_matters: Robotik gercek dunyaya indiginde verimlilik, uretim yapisi ve is gucu dengesi degisir. Bu sinyal özellikle autonomous, robot ekseninde öne çıkıyor.

headlines.summary: Nvidia, Intel, ASML, SK Hynix, and SoftBank were among the hardest-hit names as investors weighed the implications of a deliberate cap on AI progress
